Thanks again for the call today — helpful to get aligned. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we don’t lose momentum.

- Use case: search + summarization across customer support transcripts; target latency < 300ms for UI snippets.
- Scale: pilot 5k monthly active users, production goal ~200k MAU over 12 months.
- Decision criteria: response quality, predictable latency, unit cost per token, security/compliance (SOC2 + data residency), and procurement timeline.

Stakeholder map (as we heard today):
- Economic buyer: Maria Gonzalez (you) — owns budget and go/no-go.
- Technical champion: Kevin Cho — infra + integration lead.
- Procurement/legal: procurement@acme.com (TBD contact person) — MSA/terms + security checklist.
- Security reviewer: likely SecurityOps and Privacy (you flagged SOC2 + residency).

Next steps I recommend:
1) We’ll share a short mutual action plan (attached: acme_mop_v1.xlsx) that captures milestones, owners, and target dates.
2) Please confirm the procurement contact and desired contract timeline (you mentioned wanting production by end of Q2).
3) I’ll loop in our pricing/ops lead if we need to discuss any discount or SLA exceptions — want to surface that early.
4) We’ll send a packaged security response summary and SOC2 evidence for your security team to review.

Attachments: redwood_sales_deck.pdf (overview), acme_mop_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan)

If that aligns, can you confirm procurement contact and whether end of Q2 is firm? Happy to schedule a 30-min follow-up demo for Kevin and SecurityOps next week.

Thanks —

Thanks — quick take from Security/Compliance: 

- SLA / data residency: We can approve a scoped exception for a non-production pilot under the following conditions:
  - Data residency: pilot data may be processed in US-only nodes for the trial period; any EU-customer data must be pseudonymized or excluded.
  - Retention: 30-day max retention on KV/cache items; automatic purge enabled.
  - Audit: request/response logging enabled and we’ll provide a read-only view to the Acme security team for the pilot window.

- Discount: Commercial makes the call; Security does not object to a conditional 12% discount if the above controls are enforced during the pilot. For anything >12% I want a clear escalation path (legal/finance sign-off).

I’ll prepare a short exception memo to attach to the deal file; Legal should still review any MSA redlines around residency/SLA.
